title: Hoisin Tofu Stir-Fry with Soba Noodles, Broccoli, Celery & Ginger

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Once the water is boiling, add noodles and cook according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water; set aside.
While the noodles are cooking, peel and mince ginger. Place in a small bowl.
Trim and thinly slice green onions crosswise; add to the bowl with the ginger.
Trim and thinly slice celery crosswise; add to the bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, garlic powder, and salt; cook, stirring occasionally, until veggies have softened, 3-4 minutes.

Add tofu, broccoli, hoisin sauce, and water to the skillet; stir to combine and cover with a lid. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until broccoli is tender and tofu is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide noodles, stir-fry, and sauce between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
